items.title: Trump tells Reuters that Qatar, Saudi Arabia want peaceful Iran deal, US ready for strikes if needed
items.summary: By Steve Holland WASHINGTON, Nov 9 (Reuters) - President Donald Trump told Reuters on Monday that Qatar and Saudi Arabia were eager for a peaceful solution on the Iran conflict but the United States was ready to resume military strikes if necessary. Trump, who met Qatar's prime minister earlier on Monday, said "Qatar would rather see a peaceful solution" and "Saudi Arabia would rather see a peaceful solution" but "we're ready to go anytime we want" with strikes.

ai.sum: Trump told Reuters that Qatar and Saudi Arabia want a peaceful Iran deal while the US is ready to resume strikes if necessary.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine showing flexibility on territory, US official says
items.summary: By Steve Holland and Humeyra Pamuk WASHINGTON, Nov 9 (Reuters) - Both Russia and Ukraine are showing some flexibility privately on the possible exchange of territory ahead of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi this week as President Donald Trump ramps up efforts to resolve the conflict, a US official said on Monday. The official, briefing reporters ahead of talks that begin on Tuesday, said security guarantees for Ukraine will be a major topic for the discussions, including the…

ai.sum: A US official says Russia and Ukraine show private flexibility on territorial exchange ahead of US-mediated Abu Dhabi talks.

items.title: Trump says US seeing 'strong inclination' to end Russia's war in Ukraine
items.summary: By Steve Holland, Humeyra Pamuk and Kanishka Singh WASHINGTON, Nov 9 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump said on Monday that Washington was seeing a "very strong inclination" towards ending Russia's war in Ukraine and that both sides were "tired of fighting." "We're having a very good conversation about that in Abu Dhabi," Trump told reporters at the White House on the eve of US-led, three-sided talks scheduled in Abu Dhabi.

ai.sum: Trump said the US sees a strong inclination on both sides to end Russia's war in Ukraine, ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Ukraine's UN envoy: Zelenskyy ready to meet Putin anywhere in world, whether at G20 or in Antarctica
items.summary: The Ukrainian side is counting on the results of the trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi, but notes that key decisions will require a face-to-face meeting between the leaders of Ukraine and Russia, which could take place "anywhere in the world" except Moscow, Ukraine's Permanent Representative to the United Nations (UN) Andriy Melnyk.

ai.sum: Ukraine's UN envoy says Zelenskyy is ready to meet Putin anywhere except Moscow, ahead of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.
